..$comment: release-type is `simple` rather than `node`: there is no package at the repository root, and the two package.json files here are private build manifests, not published packages. The extra-files below are the three JSON fields that can hold a plain semver. The Stream Deck manifest's Version is deliberately absent — its validator demands {major}.{minor}.{patch}.{build}, so stream-deck/scripts/build-profile.mjs derives it from claude-code/.claude-plugin/plugin.json at build time and scripts/check-versions.mjs asserts they agree. include-component-in-tag stays false so the tag is plain vX.Y.Z, which is what release.yml's successor and the README's download link expect. The sections use Keep a Changelog vocabulary because CHANGELOG.md declares that format and its 3.0.0 entry already uses those headings.
